definitions.explanation: Machines, tools, and materials needed for a specific task or activity. Commonly used for film/video equipment, audio gear, construction materials, and other specialized equipment that is transported and set up for use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧{機材|きざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧{機材|きざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: It's tough to carry heavy equipment.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{音響|おんきょう}→音響：16316_onkyou⟧{機材|きざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧セッティング⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Before the concert, the staff set up the audio equipment.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine, mechanism) + ⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (material, timber). Literally "machine materials" — the machines and materials needed for work.

USAGE:
{機材|きざい} implies portable or deployable equipment — things you bring to a location, set up, and use. It is commonly associated with film/video production, audio engineering, photography, construction, and events. Unlike ⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧ (which emphasizes the devices themselves), {機材|きざい} includes the idea of materials and supplies alongside the machines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧{機材|きざい}: filming/photography equipment
- ⟦{音響|おんきょう}→音響：16316_onkyou⟧{機材|きざい}: audio equipment
- ⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧{機材|きざい}: lighting equipment
- {機材|きざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{搬入|はんにゅう}→搬入：16523_hannyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bring in equipment
- {機材|きざい}⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧: equipment trouble

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧: equipment, devices (more formal, technical)
- ⟦{器具|きぐ}→器具：03980_kigu⟧: instruments, utensils (smaller items)
- ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: tools (general, everyday)
